data.title: Binghatti Orchid
data.about:
Situated at the core of a bustling cityscape, Binghatti Orchid stands as a beacon of luxury and reprieve. Drawing inspiration from the refined beauty and poise of the orchid flower, this distinguished property unfolds as a true masterpiece in architectural brilliance, resonating with peace and calmness at every corner.

Every facet of the building, down to its thoughtfully conceived balcony design, not only offers residents a personal slice of outdoor paradise but also champions sustainability. The intelligent construction optimizes shade, significantly reducing the energy demands for cooling the interiors, thereby blending indulgence with eco-conscious living.

Choose from an array of living spaces, including modern studios and one or two-bedroom apartments, each promising a home where elegance meets convenience, and where every day invites you to live in a harmony of luxury and nature's grace. Discover your haven of opulence and comfort at Binghatti Orchid.

location_tile.title: Prime Location in JVC
location_tile.heading: location
location_tile.description:
Nestled in the bustling yet family-friendly neighborhood of Jumeirah Village Circle (JVC), Binghatti Orchid enjoys a location that perfectly blends convenience and style. JVC is renowned for offering a tranquil suburban lifestyle while being in close proximity to the vibrant hotspots of Dubai. This sought-after locale ensures that residents have easy access to a myriad of amenities including shopping malls, top-notch healthcare facilities, reputable schools, and a plethora of entertainment venues.

AREAS NEARBY:

  • 03 Minutes to Al Khail Avenue Mall 
  • 05 Minutes to City Centre Al Barsha
  • 07 Minutes to Mall of the Emirates 
  • 05 Minutes to Mediclinic Parkview Hospitals
